name: Trouble in the Valley

angles.text: Seeing soldiers bearing the sea green and anchor colors of the island realm of Kul Tiras operating in the valley marks a rare and unexpected encounter with this reclusive human seafaring nation.

faq.answer: A sharpshooter spotted a detachment of Kul Tiran soldiers searching for something in the valley below. They established an encampment near a wrecked caravan to the south, prompting local scouts to investigate their unusual motives.
faq.q: What are Kul Tiran soldiers doing in the valley?

faq.answer: The soldiers have established their encampment near a ruined caravan located to the south of the scouting vantage point overlooking the valley.
faq.q: Where is the Kul Tiran camp located?

faq.answer: A scout watching over the valley used a rifle scope to inspect the mysterious human group from afar, easily recognizing the distinctive uniform and insignia of Kul Tiras.
faq.q: How was the Kul Tiran presence discovered?

faq.answer: The task requires traveling south toward the wrecked caravan, confronting the Kul Tiran soldiers positioned there, and discovering what drew them to search the area.
faq.q: What is the objective of investigating the camp?

faq.answer: Because an armed contingent of foreign soldiers is actively scouring the territory around a destroyed caravan without explanation, scouts consider them a threat that must be subdued to uncover their intentions.
faq.q: Why are the Kul Tiran soldiers treated as enemies?

faq.answer: Walton, the hermit tanner watching over the valley, first identified the soldiers through his rifle scope and hired an adventurer to eliminate them and learn why they were there.
faq.q: Who detected the soldiers in the valley?

sections.body: A vigilant rifleman scanning the lowlands spotted a squad of human soldiers scouring the valley floor. Using a rifle scope to peer closely, the scout clearly identified the heraldry and livery of the maritime nation of Kul Tiras. Their unexpected presence in the valley immediately raised alarm, as armed foreigners rarely operate so brazenly without drawing attention.
sections.title: Suspicious Activity in the Valley

sections.body: The soldiers took up position near a ruined caravan situated to the south. Whatever drew them to the wrecked wagon remains an urgent mystery. Local observers have deemed the intrusive armed presence an immediate concern, sending investigators to eliminate the soldiers and uncover the true purpose of their expedition.
sections.title: The Wrecked Caravan

summary: Trouble in the Valley centers on a mysterious squad of Kul Tiran soldiers discovered scouring the valley floor. Armed troops have set up camp near a wrecked caravan to the south, prompting local scouts to seek their elimination and uncover the purpose behind their unexpected search.
attribution: In-game quest text: Trouble in the Valley
